omet-01-c3.text: McGrady group, Department of Chemistry, University of Oxford. On electron counting rules: doublet, octet and 18-electron. University of Oxford, Department of Chemistry lecture/article PDF.
omet-01-c3.quote: The ‘16-electron rule’ states that square-planar compounds have a stable electron count of 16 rather than the 18 that we expect of transition metal compounds.
omet-01-c3.claim: Square-planar d^8 complexes (Pt(II), Pd(II), Rh(I), Ir(I)) prefer 16 electrons
